text:
Maya Lopez: Quick check-in tiny PLG pilot idea: pair a short launch post + 9-min micro demo + tiered credit ladder to nudge first-template-tries. small cohort (~450). thoughts?
Ravi Shah: solid. what's the single-sentence hypothesis?
Maya Lopez: webinar exposure + small credit on read -> faster template adoption vs credits alone. expect lift in 7-day template usage.
Ellen Park: suggest 3 arms: (1) demo invite + $20 milestone credit on attend, (2) $15 read credit only, (3) control. N=450, run 10 days.
Marco Alvarez: routing: utm=demo -> arm1, paid-social -> arm2 or arm3 random, organic -> random all. cap demo seats at 275/week. overflow -> waitlist + $5 consolation.
Ravi Shah: onboarding treatment: demo attendees see a 3-card "sparkline prompt pack" after sign-up with one-click run. product can do this behind a flag.
infra-bot: created feature flag experiments/sparkline_pack_v1 (canary=40) :white_check_mark:
Ellen Park: email cadence for arm1: invite, -24h reminder, -15m reminder, replay + redeem link. include quick CTA: "Try 1 template now".
Maya Lopez: metrics: day1_template_try_pct, week1_retention, time_to_first_api_call_median, credit_redeem_rate. also capture replay_watch_pct.
Marco Alvarez: analytics events I'll add: demo_invite, demo_rsvp, demo_attended, pack_shown, template_ran, credit_claimed, first_api_call.
Ravi Shah: small config snippet for ops:
```yaml
experiment_id: sparkline_microlab_1959
cohort_size: 450
arms:
  - name: demo_plus_milestone
    demo_invite: true
    milestone_credit_usd: 20
  - name: read_credit
    demo_invite: false
    milestone_credit_usd: 15
  - name: control
    demo_invite: false
    milestone_credit_usd: 0
traffic_rules:
  - if: utm_campaign==demo -> assign:demo_plus_milestone
  - else: random_assign(read_credit, control)
metrics:
  - day1_template_try_pct
  - week1_retention
  - time_to_first_api_call_median
```
Ellen Park: owners: landing & copy = Maya, emails = Ellen, FF + onboarding push = Marco, analytics = Ravi, credits = @finance-ops.
Maya Lopez: timeline: landing + post copy by Mon EOD, flag canary + QA Tue AM, launch Wed.
Marco Alvarez: tagging @finance-ops to confirm credit provisioning and anti-abuse checks.
Ravi Shah: I'll wire dashboard and set a 48h alert for template_try_rate spike.
Maya Lopez: last ask  keep messaging concise and emphasize "9-min demo + $20 when you attend". Anyone object?
Ellen Park: :thumbsup: from me.
Marco Alvarez: :thumbsup:
Ravi Shah: :thumbsup:
Maya Lopez: great  booking 15-min runbook tomorrow 9:30 to finalize. :rocket:
